bootstrap.method: class-stratified source-group cluster bootstrap, percentile 95% CI
bootstrap.estimand: Pooled image metrics: every image has equal weight; larger sources contribute more images. Secondary source_balanced_accuracy averages within-source image accuracy equally over sources; class_balanced_source_accuracy first averages sources within class, then averages all fixed classes. Neither is multiview voting.
bootstrap.macro_class_policy: Fixed classes in every draw; absent-class precision/recall/F1 and class-balanced source accuracy contribute zero. Balanced accuracy uses observed true classes only.
bootstrap.caveat: Approximate stratified-family bootstrap of fixed predictions when stratification is enabled. Keeps every image with its source draw multiplicity. Does NOT capture refitting, model-selection uncertainty, or dependent CV training sets. For fresh holdout, assumes independent new source groups; 21-35 groups yield limited uncertainty resolution. Singleton strata cannot estimate within-class source variation. Undefined replicates are omitted per metric; inspect n_valid. No fold stratification.

accuracy_threshold_assessment.note: A point estimate >=80% does not imply a 95% CI lower bound >=80%.

scopes.warm: Predecoded, EXIF-oriented in-memory PIL RGB images -> exact family preprocessing -> tensor stacking and device transfer -> resident eval models -> saved head -> class-order probabilities in host NumPy memory. Includes feature assembly and CPU classifier for frozen recipes. Excludes disk I/O, decoding/EXIF orientation, artifact loading, hashing, result validation/serialization and thread-pool setup. Float32 network inference; family-specific probability precision preserved. Same declared image batch repeated; no feature or tensor cache.
scopes.process_warm_reload: Same-process artifact reload plus one predecoded image through probabilities; includes existing loader metadata/runtime/hash checks and model construction. The artifact was already loaded once for preflight; Python imports and library caches remain warm, and OS file caches are not flushed. Models are released and CUDA allocator cache emptied between trials. Not full CLI startup, not an OS-cold or fresh-process measurement.

frozen_selected.memory_scope: CUDA process allocator peaks, including resident model weights; reserved memory can retain earlier batch allocations. Not total board usage. CPU VRAM fields are null; no CPU RSS claim.

deployment.dependency_note: Pinned cached pretrained safetensors required; joblib is only scaler/head.
deployment.parameter_scope: Runtime: unique resident Parameter objects plus fitted head coef/intercept. Unique source: each (weight-file SHA256, used parameter name) once using original checkpoint shapes, plus fitted head; neural: exported model parameters. Excludes buffers/scaler state and discarded pretrained classifier parameters. File bytes include complete files and are not inferred from parameter counts.

frozen_selected.validation: Identical development manifest, content, selected images and settings across all four; dependency bytes/hashes and timing sample counts verified.

gpu_release_note: All original and additionally authorized exploratory predictor/robustness/benchmark subprocesses exited; this executor holds no GPU models.

exploratory_robustness.scope: Post hoc descriptive comparison added after clean scores and primary corruptions were observed; exactly the existing five conditions; no training, model selection or new conditions.

limitations: Restricted synthetic source holdout; no claim of arbitrary real-world recognition or audited absence from backbone pretraining data.
Primary remains frozen_selected; exploratory DINO clean ranking and post hoc robustness do not change selection.
Warm benchmarking starts from predecoded RGB and includes preprocessing, model computation and probabilities; excludes disk image I/O/decode.
Reload timings are process-warm model reloads, not fresh-process or OS-cold startup.
GPU memory is process allocator peak, not total device usage; deployment storage includes required pretrained files and sidecars.
